name: Coffee Shop Owner
text: Hi, I run the local coffee shop. Have you seen my son? He's supposed to be helping me sweep...

name: Frog
text: No, I haven't. What does he look like?

name: Coffee Shop Owner
text: Like disappointment. He's wearing a bag with a skull charm and complaining about the 'societal expectations of lily pads.' If you see him, let me know.

name: Frog
text: Okay, if I see him around, I'll let you know.
